assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one standalone navigation icon for a cybersecurity desktop app, designed to display at 32x32.
Input image role: the supplied TTP icon is a STYLE AND COLOR REFERENCE only. Create a new category-specific symbol; do not copy its internal hierarchy/checkmark into every icon.
Style: chunky professional pixel art matching the reference, bold staircase contours and dark-blue pixel outline, solid vivid blue #007acc and light blue #4daafc accents, dark charcoal #1e1e1e where needed, small near-white highlights. One uniform logical pixel grid, roughly 32x32 design enlarged on square canvas; clean flat pixel clusters, minimal details, visually legible when reduced to a small toolbar icon.
Composition: single centered symbol occupying 80 percent of square canvas, even 10 percent transparent outer margins, similar visual weight to the reference.
Background: truly transparent outside the subject. Keep enclosed dark interiors opaque.
Constraints: no lettering, no labels, no watermark, no multiple alternatives, no contact sheet, no mockup, no background pattern or tile, no official MITRE branding, no smooth vector curves, no blur or external glow, no detailed texture, no perspective. Just one pixel icon.
Category: Mitigations.
Definition: security concepts and technologies that prevent successful execution of adversary techniques.
Subject: a bold blue protective shield containing a short white brick barrier. No checkmark, no nodes; clearly distinct from the reference TTP shield.
